# Apartment Maintenance Log

## Recurring tasks

- descale the kettle every month
- clean the bathroom drain every six weeks
- vacuum refrigerator coils twice per year

## Supplies to keep

- microfiber cloths
- white vinegar
- replacement vacuum bags
- spare light bulbs in warm white

## Winter note

If a window starts fogging between panes, record the room, date, and outside temperature before contacting the building manager.
